metadata.description: USAP — Unified Security Agent Platform. Open-source AI cybersecurity skills marketplace.

plugins.name: usap
plugins.description: 79 cybersecurity skills + 12 cs-* orchestrator agents. Bundles 7 slash commands and 6 user-invocable orchestrator skills (Alex, CISO, DevSecOps, IR, Program Manager, Red Team). Every skill emits a typed 11-field JSON output contract mapped to MITRE ATT&CK and NIST CSF 2.0. Apache 2.0, runs in any LLM.
